name: venus-webgpu
description: Venus (virtio-gpu Vulkan) to WebGPU bridge for browser Linux

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --external naga-wasm && bun build src/transport/unkernel.ts --outdir dist/transport --target browser --external naga-wasm && bun build demo/demo.ts --outdir demo/dist --target browser && cp node_modules/naga-wasm/dist/wasm/naga_bg.wasm demo/dist/naga_bg.wasm && cp node_modules/naga-wasm/dist/wasm/naga_bg.wasm dist/naga_bg.wasm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && find dist -name '*.d.ts' -exec sed -i.bak 's/\.ts";/.js";/g' {} + && find dist -name '*.d.ts.bak' -delete
